summary: Canadian National Railway Company filed a Form 6-K disclosing the results of its annual meeting of shareholders held on May 1, 2026. All 11 director nominees listed in the management information circular were elected, with Shauneen Bruder re-elected as board chair. This is a routine procedural filing of election results and contains no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews.
